title: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 2005
summary: First priority: preserve the original golf presentation while rebuilding for Apple Silicon and a 2560 × 1600 display.
notes: Original Windows disc media is present. It is reference material, not a native game.
A separate development prototype in this library demonstrates the native rendering and input foundation. It is not a finished PGA Tour 2005 port.
Original course geometry, player models, animations, game rules, audio, and modes still need reconstruction and validation.
Compiled Windows media does not include high-level game source. A native rewrite needs substantial reverse engineering, asset decoding, implementation, and comparison with original behavior.
keyboard: Planned: native keyboard and trackpad controls.
controller: Planned: Xbox / extended gamepad controls; hardware compatibility must be tested.
